proposals.reason: Evidenced rebrand of an operating bank: Nest Bank retired the 2016 launch-era mark (dark-brown circle with light-blue nest swirl, the accepted SVG) in favor of the violet 'N!' monogram (violet #BCA8FF on graphite), used as the portal favicon, site header logo and press-kit sygnet. The official online-banking portal publishes an original standalone vector of the new mark (favicon.svg, three filled paths, not a raster wrapper), which is the candidate.
